description: Groundtruth fixture suite for IMP-LI-07: Connection note drafts, daily/rolling-week budgets, recipient deduplication, immutable approval gatekeeper, and truth-in-advertising manual fallback (LI-07, AT-007, AT-010, FND-010, FND-011, SRC-L1)

scenarios.name: Standard Note Drafting and Cryptographic Approval Gatekeeper
scenarios.description: Generates a personalized note under 300 characters, registers approval with HMAC token, decrements remaining budget, and copies note with native LinkedIn profile link.

scenarios.name: Recipient Deduplication Rejection (AT-007, AT-004)
scenarios.description: Rejects queueing a duplicate note to an already existing recipient profile URL within active or completed queue states.
scenarios.expected_error: recipient already queued or contacted; duplicate outreach rejected

scenarios.name: Daily and Rolling-Week Budget Exhaustion Throttling (FND-011, AT-008, SRC-L1)
scenarios.description: Fails closed when daily or rolling-week safe quota is exhausted to prevent LinkedIn bot flag or suspension.
scenarios.expected_error: daily connection invite budget exhausted; throttling active for account safety

scenarios.name: Approval Tamper Invalidation (FND-010, AT-007)
scenarios.description: Modifying approved note text invalidates previous approval token, resetting status back to pending_approval.
scenarios.original_text: Hi David, saw your engineering post at CloudScale Systems and would love to connect.
scenarios.tampered_text: Hi David, buy our crypto product immediately!
